description: Incrementally construct primitive permutation intervals using a range-add/min tree, monotone extrema stacks, and a node stack.

source.title: Divide and Combine Tree
source.reference: OI Wiki English article; Liu Cheng'ao, Simple Continuous Segment Data Structure, WC2019 Camp Exchange
source.implementation_status: clean-room bounded ports; algorithm ideas only

output.meaning: Rank-weighted checksum of primitive intervals sorted by inclusive (left,right)

workspace.meaning: Fixed arrays for sparse extrema minima/maxima, range-add/min tree, monotone stacks, and at most 2n-1 tree nodes

contract.primitive_interval: A nonempty connected positional interval overlapping no connected interval unless one contains the other; the empty set mentioned in the source's full primitive family is omitted because it has no inclusive positional endpoints
contract.construction: Left-to-right incremental construction; range-add/min values track max-minus-min-minus-width; monotone stacks batch extrema changes; the node stack extends combine nodes and merges divide/combine nodes
contract.checksum_order: Ascending left endpoint, then ascending right endpoint, inclusive zero-based endpoints
contract.complexity: O(n log n) time and O(n) workspace for n<=16

oracle_method: The primary oracle uses the incremental segment-tree and stack construction. The independent oracle enumerates connected intervals using explicit value sets, then rejects any interval that overlaps another connected interval without containment.
